prompt: How many votes did the opposition party get in the Brant riding the election before Justin Trudeau was elected Prime Minister?
answer: In the **2011 federal election**, the opposition party—the **New Democratic Party (NDP)**—received **16,351 votes** in the Brant riding. Its candidate was **Marc Laferriere**.
